description: This file defines a template class QueueType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class implements a thread-safe producer-consumer queue with methods for adding, removing, inserting, extracting, enabling, disabling, and flushing queue entries. It manages internal state with synchronization primitives and enforces non-copyable semantics. The file includes external dependencies on synchronization and state management modules and is intended for use as a core component in a larger C++ project.

classes.name: QueueType
classes.description: A thread-safe, producer-consumer queue template class that manages entries with high water mark, supports insertion, removal, extraction, and state control, designed for concurrent environments.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific entry from the queue if it exists.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Adds an entry to the queue if not disabled.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Attempts to insert an entry into the queue, waiting up to a specified time if the queue is full.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the first entry from the queue, waiting up to a specified time if the queue is empty.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the queue, preventing further operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all entries from the queue; only allowed when disabled.

methods.name: FreeSlot
methods.description: Waits until a slot is available in the queue.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: IsFull
methods.description: Checks if the queue has reached its maximum capacity.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries in the queue.
